title: Foundation-model MRI framework predicts deep myometrial invasion in endometrial cancer
summary: A multimodal deep-learning framework using a vision foundation model, two MRI sequences and clinicopathological variables was developed on 1,376 patients from seven centers. The best model reached AUCs of 0.832-0.877 across the internal and four external cohorts, with no significant difference from experienced radiologists (P = 0.915). The study is retrospective.
ai_technology: Vision foundation model-enhanced multimodal deep-learning radiomics with cross-sequence attention
organization: Jiangmen Central Hospital; First Affiliated Hospital of Jinan University

evidence.tested: Performance was assessed in an internal validation cohort and four external cohorts, with comparison to radiologists.
evidence.unknown: Prospective use and effect on surgical planning are not tested. Abstract-based; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A foundation-model-based deep-learning signature on dual MRI sequences was combined with clinical variables.
